gloss: queen consort; queen (wife of a king)

definitions.gloss: queen consort; queen (wife of a king)
definitions.explanation: The wife of a king. Distinct from a queen regnant (女王, a queen who rules in her own right). Used for both historical and contemporary royal contexts.

examples.japanese: {王妃|おうひ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{国民|こくみん}→国民：02757_kokumin⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{愛|あい}された→愛する：01811_aisuru⟧。
examples.english: The queen was loved by the people.

examples.japanese: {若|わか}き{王妃|おうひ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{美|うつく}しさ⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{知|し}られていた→知る：00458_shiru⟧。
examples.english: The young queen was known for her beauty.

examples.japanese: マリー・アントワネット⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦フランス→フランス：19418_furansu⟧⟦{最後|さいご}→最後：01413_saigo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{王妃|おうひ}⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦{歴史|れきし}→歴史：02267_rekishi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{名|な}→名：03496_na⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{残|のこ}した→残す：01975_nokosu⟧。
examples.english: Marie Antoinette left her mark on history as the last queen of France.

notes:
USAGE:
Refers specifically to the wife of a king, not to a ruling queen. For a female monarch who rules in her own right, use ⟦{女王|じょおう}→女王：03349_joou⟧.

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{女王|じょおう}→女王：03349_joou⟧: queen regnant (a queen who rules)
- ⟦{王|おう}→王：19353_ou⟧: king
- ⟦{皇后|こうごう}→皇后：16354_kougou⟧: empress (wife of an emperor, used for the Japanese imperial family)
- ⟦{妃|きさき}→妃：14750_kisaki⟧/{妃|ひ}: consort, princess (more general term)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {王妃|おうひ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{座|ざ}→座：28170_za⟧: the throne/position of queen
- {王妃|おうひ}{殿下|でんか}: Her Majesty the Queen
- {王妃|おうひ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{迎|むか}える→迎える：01193_mukaeru⟧: to welcome a queen consort
